findings.problem: The singular arm names no noun while the plural arms do ('incluidos 2 chats que no están activos'), so the two arms are not symmetrical. At the previous head the singular did name it ('incluido {elsewhere, number, ::group-off} chat no activo'), so the remediation dropped the noun from the singular arm only while keeping 'chats' in the plural. In the accessible name a listener hears two adjacent bare numbers ('...leídos (1), incluido 1 ...'). It remains grammatical and idiomatic Spanish - the participle agrees with the implied 'chat', and this catalogue's own notices use bare singular counts ('ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_unknown': '1 no se pudo borrar y sigue sin leer.') - so this is a preference for symmetry and an explicit referent, not a defect.
findings.suggested: one {incluido {elsewhere, number, ::group-off} chat que no está activo} - same substitution in both keys; this keeps the relative clause the prior round asked for, keeps the leading comma so the label stays a prefix, and makes the singular mirror the plural arm.

Rendered matrix (Python ICU render, CLDR es selection, NOT node/Intl execution): count 1 -> 'Marcar 1 chat sin leer como leído.'; 2/12/999999 -> other; 1000000 -> many with the partitive 'de' the style guide's own example requires ('Marcar 1000000 de chats sin leer como leídos.'); tokenless 1/2/1000000 -> 'No se puede borrar 1 marca ...' / 'No se pueden borrar 2 marcas ...' / 'No se pueden borrar 1000000 de marcas ...'.

Sentence joining: scope_tokenless carries exactly one full stop in every arm. scope_chats_elsewhere's single '.' sits outside the trailing plural, so the whole message has exactly one full stop and its arms correctly carry none. scope_joined is '{chats} {tokenless}' - a single space, the es separator, adding no words - so the joined output is two clean sentences: 'Marcar 5 chats sin leer como leídos, incluidos 2 chats que no están activos. No se pueden borrar 2 marcas de mensajes sin leer que no tienen token de finalización.' No run-on, no doubled stop.

Accessible name: label + name_suffix_elsewhere keeps the label an unbroken prefix in every sampled case (verified by string prefix test, e.g. 'Marcar todos como leídos (5), incluidos 2 chats que no están activos'); the tail begins with ', ' (no space before the comma, per es typography) and ends with no punctuation.

'Not active' stays the backend class and not a section name: es renders it descriptively as 'que no está activo' / 'que no están activos', never as a heading, and never as 'Running'. The catalogue's own class word for the active set is supported by ui.chat.sidebar_view.active_first 'Activos primero'; no sidebar section is called 'Activos' (sections are by time).

'token' stays English and qualified descriptively in 'token de finalización', so it does not read as a security token; the catalogue keeps English 'token' elsewhere (ui.chat.device.sentence.pairing_guidance, ui.chat.skill_invocation.trigger_label).

Verb pair: 'marcar como leído' for the action and 'se borró la marca de mensajes sin leer' for clearing are the pair already audited in ui.chat.read_ack.refusal.refused and ui.notices.chat.unread_not_cleared 'No se borraron las marcas de mensajes sin leer.'; the tooltip is internally consistent with the visible label ('Marcar todos como leídos'), and en splits the same two verbs ('Mark ... as read' / 'cannot be cleared').

Register: infinitive action wording per the es guide ('Marcar'), tú-neutral, no 'usted', no region-marked words, sentence case, no '!', no hand-written punctuation inside code spans; digits Latin; only precomposed accented characters (U+00ED/U+00E1/U+00F3) - no combining marks, no wide-glyph width risk.
Typography: quotes, em dash and ellipsis rules not engaged by these five keys; no space before punctuation; no double spaces, no leading/trailing whitespace in any of the five values (byte scan).
